english:
Firstly, I thank Mother and Jesus countless times that I am able to stand on this holy land where Mother appeared.
The first thing I want to say is that in 2018 I took the Covenant for the first time. After that, for some time, I broke the Covenant. Then, I was affected by a disease called Facial Nerve Palsy.
My face paralysed to one side, and one side of my eye, nose, and lips all got pulled to one side completely.
That was the condition I reached. At that time my mind was terribly troubled, and I would always watch the testimonies from Kreupasanam daily.
No one would be at home then. I would watch these testimonies every day, and in my heart I felt that I should go close to Mother and renew the Covenant and live
in Mother’s Covenant itself. While I was in that situation, after this illness came, when I went to the hospital for consultation,
the doctor said… I asked the doctor, “When will this paralysed in my face go away? I am not able to travel on the bus. Because my face is bent to one side,
everyone keeps staring at my face, and mentally I feel extremely distressed. One of my eyes was closed, so I
used to wear spectacles and a mask on my face while travelling by bus to go for physiotherapy. Mentally,
I was completely broken while traveling by bus. In such a state, one night at 3 AM, I couldn’t sleep at all.
With a mind that was completely numb with fear, at 3 in the night I came before Mother and Jesus,
and I asked Mother, “Mother, I am praying so much, right? Then why is the illness in my face not getting healed?” I asked. At that moment,
I received the Word of God. Matthew chapter 5, verse 24 — “First, go and be reconciled with your brother and then come back; you will receive healing.” When you offer your sacrifice,
if your brother has anything against you, reconcile with him first and then come — this was the verse I received for the first time.
The very next day was Saturday.
It was a Saturday. That day itself, in the morning, I decided that I must go to church and make a confession, because the Holy Confession is
such a powerful sacrament through which we receive repentance and transformation.
The first thing is — for the past three years, I had been filled with anger, bitterness,
grief, and pain toward my own brother. That very moment, as soon as I got down from the bus, I called him. I phoned him and at that moment, I felt as if something
left my heart. Then I went for confession, and during confession I opened up everything — all my sins.
Through confession and through this Word, the Lord brought me closer to Mother. And when I came home that evening,
I don’t even know where the illness on my face disappeared. Even the doctors had said, “We don’t know when this will get better.” I was at zero merit.
The doctors said they couldn’t say anything for sure — they couldn’t guarantee that my face would return to normal.
It was then that I understood: what is impossible for humans is possible for God.
I was mentally destroyed in that condition. No one could save me — only Jesus and Mother brought me out of that situation. Then this thought began in me — I must renew my Covenant.
After my rest period was over, I came here immediately and renewed the Covenant. I renewed the Covenant and when I returned home,
When I reached home, we noticed a variation in my husband’s heart. When the ECG was taken, there was a severe variation.
His blood pressure increased; terrible tension and chest pain came. When we went to Lissy Hospital, the doctor said, “There might be a block in the heart.
We must do a test to confirm.” The doctor clearly told us that these are symptoms of a block. In that completely broken situation,
I did not let go of Mother. I held on to the Covenant and prayed, “Mother, remove the block from my husband’s heart.” After that,
when the test was done, there was no block. There was only a small hole in the heart — a hole present from birth — nothing serious, and it could be cured with medicine, they said.
Every day, for the heart, I prayed and used what we call the Faith prayer. It is something truly miraculous. If everyone does it with faith, it will happen the same way for them. If we pray
with faith and use it, it will immediately work. I believed and prayed, and according to the Covenant, first I apply it on forehead,
and then during prayer, I apply it on my forehead — and also on my children — on their chests, and everywhere necessary. And by applying it on his chest and through Mother’s miracle,
the block disappeared, and only a small hole remained, which Mother gave back healed. Then the third thing I want to say is about my elder daughter — she had PCOD.
Her periods were never regular; she would get them only once in four months. Every day during prayer,
by saying the Faith prayer, I used to make the sign of the Cross on her stomach again and again. And the very next month, her periods became regular.
Then the fourth thing I want to share — my younger daughter had a lump-like swelling on her palm. She is studying B.Sc. Nursing in Bangalore.
She had a one-week vacation then. She said, “Mom, I have exams next week. I won’t be able to hold a pen to write.” I told her,
“Come home, there’s one week, right? We will apply the oil and salt from Kreupasanam, and we will remove this through Mother’s grace.” She said,
“Mom, we need to show the doctor too.” I told her, “Yes, we will show the doctor also.” We showed her to two doctors — even at Lissy Hospital. The surgeon said,
“We have no other option. It is growing. It must be operated and removed.” Then I told the doctor… My daughter asked the doctor,
“How much will the surgery cost?” The doctor said it would cost 10 thousand rupees. But that day,
I didn’t even have ten rupees with me. That was the situation when my daughter came. I thought, “What will I do?” Then I said, “Don’t worry, my child.
We have our Mother with us, right? Then why should we fear?” Immediately, I took the Covenant oil and blessed salt and started saying the Faith Proclamation.
Then my daughter said, “Mom, I only have one week. In this one week how will you heal something that the doctor said must be operated?” I said,
“Our Mother is with us. With this Covenant oil and salt and by making the sign of the Cross,
I will apply it every day during prayer.” For that one week — yes, just one week — I kept asking Mother. And within that one week, I don’t know
where the swelling in my daughter’s hand disappeared. In the same way, even though I had desires, my faith was sometimes weak. So first,
my first intention in my Covenant was to receive the Anointing of the Holy Spirit. My second intention was that my children and husband
should come into faith — with a clear sign — I wanted them to be led into faith. And Mother and Jesus gave that sign and brought them into faith.
Then, as a part of apostolate work, I distribute the papers everywhere. I never take them to parish churches.
Because if I take them there, people may insult and destroy them. I do not want that. I go to bus stands and to houses,
and I give the papers to those who are troubled, looking sad, broken, and in pain. I share my experience with everyone like that.
I have even brought two or three people here into the faith. Also, as a charity work, I go to an old age home… I give them food,
and I visit them. I visit the sick as well. For all these blessings, I thank Mother and Jesus countless times.
Finally, I want to say — there is no point living with fights and resentment with our brothers and sisters.
Reconciling and living in peace is the most important. And it is through the sacraments that we are led into faith — this is what I want to say. I thank Mother and Jesus
countless times. Ephesians 4:32 — “Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as God forgave you in Christ.” This sister,
Hency Johnson, shared with us her testimony of living the Covenant life. Dear ones,
no matter how small we may think we are, no matter how far we have gone from God till today — if we are willing to return once,
if we are willing to humble ourselves before God once, and if we are ready to believe that God is enough for my life — when I seek His Kingdom and His righteousness,
He will add everything else to my life — if we are ready to believe that, the Covenant life will take our lives through great transformations.
The model we receive when we take the Covenant is Mary — a model of a life surrendered to fulfill God’s will.
With complete reliance on God, even through the deepest pains of life, Mother lifted her head, held her Son close, walked forward,
and offered her life itself as a sacrifice to fulfill God’s will. Therefore, it is not about how others treat us —
it is about how we can offer our life as a sacrifice in the presence of God. When we begin to think like that, the course of our life will change.
Every good work we do will not go unrewarded. Every sacrifice we make in faith will never go without reward.
When we humble ourselves in the presence of God, He will continue to bless our lives with great things.
This family is sharing such testimonies of blessings — how they tried to humble themselves before God, to ask forgiveness,
to surrender themselves and their family into God’s presence — and how God accepted it and worked in their lives.
Dear ones, God is always ready to bless each one of us.
Mother will hold our hands and is always willing to lead us out of any pit or hardship and present us to Jesus. If we are ready to humble ourselves a little,
let go of the harshness in our life, and decide to live in God’s love,
we will continue to experience the great works of God. For that, we can entrust ourselves into the hands of our Mother.
Let us pray for the grace to forgive. Without arguing or justifying ourselves, let us stand before God ready to admit our shortcomings,
and the chains will break, sickness will be healed, life’s situations will be taken care of. We will witness great blessings before our eyes and glorify the name of the Lord.
As this family has testified, let us pray that we too may become witnesses to Mother’s apparitions.
With a clap of hands, let us offer this testimony in the presence of God.
